The 2024/2025 representation review changes this council for the next periodic election: 5 to 4 wards. This page preserves the preceding source ward, and must not be used as the upcoming-election ward map. See the linked ECSA review/gazette source; new geometry and successor joins remain unresolved.

From polling day of the next periodic election, four wards named Ward 1 to Ward 4 each elect three councillors. The retained five-ward polygons are a preceding edition. Gazette 2025-12-11, p. 4936; https://www.ecsa.sa.gov.au/images/Council_Boundaries_2026/Playford_Gazette%20Notice_11%20December%202025.pdf

All2022 ordinary-event candidates come from ECSA master/control workbooks; contested first preferences come from the separate official council results workbook. Source-published historical outcome corrections are retained as published. These records do not establish current office or completion of later by-election/recount histories.
Party membership in the historical master is retained separately and is not treated as party endorsement.

All 2022 ordinary-event candidates come from ECSA master/control workbooks; contested first preferences come from the separate official council results workbook. Source-published historical outcome corrections are retained as published. These records do not establish current office or completion of later by-election/recount histories.

Official institutional website comes from the public LGA-SA directory snapshot declared 23 September 2026, checked 17 October 2026. The full copyrighted workbook and contact details remain local-only.

Only the independently published council leader is supplied here. Complete current councillor rosters and individual profiles remain unpopulated unless separately sourced; historical2022 winners are not used as current-office evidence.
Declared scope is this place route, visible implementation date, breadcrumbs, choices and canonical place identity/boundary pins only.
This manifest does not claim a complete civic journey, current source/legal correctness, full biographies or full historical contestant coverage.
Geometry, people, candidate measures and timing received only the actual checks recorded in the linked national report; their missing coverage remains explicit there.

Browser evidence is a shared-renderer smoke review of its recorded fixtures and viewport/device conditions. It does not establish full per-place source, geometry, mobile, accessibility or browser review.
No new Twinkles were authored; grassroots implementation remains open. A structural PASS is not a national completeness claim.
